change.source: finding 6 (the record of the chat posts is never pruned): no pruning in this story by the coordinator's decision; the lifetime of an entry is settled by the stories that read the record; docs/design/bridge.md and the limits page say what happens at the bound of 64 MiB: every post ends the bridge with 4 after the post was made, and a restart posts the same message again as a replay at connectors, until the operator removes or shortens the record
